newsitem.title: SPAIN: Spain studies up to 35 pct Endesa sale.
newsitem.headline: Spain studies up to 35 pct Endesa sale.

text.p: The Spanish government is to study the privatisation a stake of up to 35 percent of Endesa at its regular cabinet meeting on Thursday, Energy Secretary Nemesio Fernandez Cuesta said on Wednesday.
"The next cabinet meeting will study the public share offering of up to a 35 percent stake of Endesa in October," Cuesta told reporters after a conference organised by the Spanish Energy Club.
The cabinet meeting is expected to kick off the privatisation process.
State holding company SEPI has a stake of around 67 percent in Endesa.
Local news agency reports said on Wednesday the privatisation committee had approved the public sale of 35 percent of Endesa in October, usually a preliminary a step to the privatisation process.
In May, Merrill Lynch, Argentaria and Santander Investment -- a unit of Banco Santander -- were appointed by SEPI as global managers for the Endesa's privatisation.
